nodes.description: Public router address 0x7a25...488D, hard-coded at declaration and auto-whitelisted in the stakers mapping.
mapping(address=>bool) privileged-controller whitelist used as the access-control gate for deposit/withdraw/_checkBalance/_logRebase.
mapping(address=>bool) transfer whitelist; only addresses flagged true may pass the _bridge require(stakers[from_]).
Private ERC20 balance ledger; written directly by _deposit, _withdraw, _bridge and _initMint.
Private nested allowance ledger written by _approve.
Private total supply, mutated by _initMint (mint), _withdraw (unbacked increase) and _burn.
Caller-controlled address; used as privilege key for controller/stakers and as implicit sender in transfer/approve paths.
QantumYearnFinance constructor: mints 750e18 to msg.sender and grants controller+staker status to msg.sender and uniV2Router.
Public function gated by require(controller[msg.sender]) that wipes the balance of an arbitrary account via _deposit.
Public function gated by require(controller[msg.sender]) that credits an arbitrary account and total supply via _withdraw.
QYFI override of ERC20._bridge; requires stakers[from_] before delegating to super._bridge.
Public controller-only function that sets stakers[account]=true, granting transfer rights.
Public controller-only function that sets stakers[account]=false, revoking transfer rights.
ERC20._bridge internal transfer routine: zero-address checks plus SafeMath sub/add on _balances and Transfer event.
Internal helper that sets _balances[acc]=0 with no accounting or event.
Internal helper that adds amount to _totalSupply and to _balances[account]; effectively an unrestricted mint controlled only by the controller flag.
ERC20 transfer public entry; routes through the overridden _bridge for the caller.
ERC20 approve public entry delegating to _approve.
ERC20 transferFrom: calls overridden _bridge then decrements the caller allowance via SafeMath sub.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks and Approval event.
Internal mint helper increasing _totalSupply and _balances[account] under SafeMath.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Raw _balances[acc]=0 write in _deposit; destroys accounting state without supply reconciliation or event.
_withdraw increases _totalSupply and credits a balance, minting value with no deposit counterpart.
_checkBalance sets stakers[account]=true, granting an arbitrary address transfer privileges.
_logRebase sets stakers[account]=false, freezing an arbitrary address from transferring.
require(stakers[from_]) in _bridge; central whitelist enforcement point for all transfers.
account argument of deposit(address).
account argument of withdraw(address,uint).
amount argument of withdraw(address,uint).
from_ argument of the QYFI _bridge override.
to_ argument of the QYFI _bridge override.
amount argument of the QYFI _bridge override.
account argument of _checkBalance(address).
account argument of _logRebase(address).
sender argument of ERC20._bridge.
recipient argument of ERC20._bridge.
amount argument of ERC20._bridge.
account argument of _initMint.
amount argument of _initMint.

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the initial 750e18 mint plus controller and staker privileges during construction.
deposit authorisation is derived directly from controller[msg.sender].
withdraw authorisation is derived directly from controller[msg.sender].
_checkBalance authorisation is derived directly from controller[msg.sender].
_logRebase authorisation is derived directly from controller[msg.sender].
msg.sender is the implicit from_ address for transfer.
_msgSender returns msg.sender which feeds the ERC20 transfer/approve/allowance paths.
deposit invokes _deposit(account) after its controller check.
withdraw invokes _withdraw(account,amount) after its controller check.
_bridge override delegates to super._bridge after the staker check.
transfer routes through the overridden _bridge so the staker gate applies.
transferFrom routes through the overridden _bridge so the staker gate applies.
approve delegates to _approve.
transferFrom decrements allowance through _approve.
constructor calls _initMint to create the initial supply.
deposit reads controller[msg.sender] as its only gate.
withdraw reads controller[msg.sender] as its only gate.
_checkBalance reads controller[msg.sender] as its only gate.
_logRebase reads controller[msg.sender] as its only gate.
constructor writes controller[msg.sender]=true, seeding permanent privilege.
constructor sets stakers[msg.sender]=true and stakers[uniV2Router]=true.
_bridge reads stakers[from_] to authorise the transfer.
_checkBalance writes stakers[account]=true with no validation of account.
_logRebase writes stakers[account]=false with no validation of account.
uniV2Router is permanently whitelisted as a staker.
constructor references the uniV2Router state variable to build the staker mapping.
_withdraw adds to _totalSupply via SafeMath, expanding supply outside any mint logic.
_withdraw credits _balances[account] via SafeMath add.
_deposit overwrites _balances[acc] with zero.
_initMint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath add.
_initMint credits _balances[account] via SafeMath add.
ERC20._bridge subtracts from sender and adds to recipient balances under SafeMath.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender]=amount.
_deposit performs the raw balance-wipe operation.
_withdraw performs the unbacked supply/balance inflation.
_checkBalance performs the arbitrary staker grant.
_logRebase performs the arbitrary staker revocation.
_bridge performs the central staker whitelist check.
deposit account parameter flows into _deposit as the wiped account.
withdraw account parameter flows into _withdraw as the credited account.
withdraw amount parameter is added to total supply and balance.
from_ parameter is used as the stakers mapping key in the gate.
to_ parameter is forwarded to the base _bridge recipient.
amount parameter is forwarded to the base _bridge SafeMath arithmetic.
account parameter is used as the stakers key granted true.
account parameter is used as the stakers key set false.
sender parameter is debited inside the base _bridge.
recipient parameter is credited inside the base _bridge.
amount parameter drives the base _bridge SafeMath sub/add.
account parameter is credited by _initMint.
amount parameter is added to _totalSupply and balance in _initMint.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core deposit parameter is a direct argument to the internal _deposit helper and can be folded into it.
The non-core withdraw parameter is a direct argument to the internal _withdraw helper and can be folded into it.
The non-core withdraw amount is consumed entirely by _withdraw's SafeMath additions.
The non-core from_ parameter is only used as the stakers key in the overridden _bridge.
The non-core to_ parameter is forwarded unchanged to the base _bridge recipient.
The non-core override amount is forwarded unchanged into the base _bridge arithmetic.
The non-core account parameter is written straight into the stakers mapping.
The non-core account parameter is written straight into the stakers mapping.
The non-core base-bridge sender is used only for the ERC20 balance debit.
The non-core base-bridge recipient is used only for the ERC20 balance credit.
The non-core base-bridge amount is used only in the SafeMath sub/add.
The non-core mint account is used only to credit _balances in _initMint.
The non-core mint amount is used only in the SafeMath add on _totalSupply/_balances.
